pages.alt: Amazon Germany Credit Card App, Munich 2018. Freelance, solo UX/UI designer; the app is used daily by 2 million users. A phone showing the app's card screen (a looping video).
Grover, Berlin 2016–2017. Chief Creative Officer: brand design, website, materials, dashboard and campaigns. The Grover logo, a white ring, on a purple to pink gradient.
TEDx Amsterdam, print design, Amsterdam 2012. A red programme with large white TEDx letters.
The College of Extraordinary Experiences, Copenhagen, 2016 to present. Branding and all materials for the experience design festival. Its winged emblem, embossed in black on dark paper.
Metabolic, rebranding and visual identity, Amsterdam 2012. Low buildings and a garden under a cyan to red colour gradient.
IEHANA™ Cosmetics, rebranding and packaging redesign, Bucharest 2019. A hand reaching out to touch a tree trunk in soft light.
DSTOQ, brand refresh and web design, Vaduz 2018. The website's start page, “Exchange Without Borders”, beside a line drawing of a hand holding a phone with the exchange app.
Mozilla, pitch, research and concept, Berlin 2017. Runners in silhouette against the low sun, the Victory Column behind them.
Stegreif Orchestra, rebranding, albums and merch design, Berlin 2016. The black and white album cover beside a red vinyl record.
FinanceFox, rebranding and app redesign, Zurich 2015. A man in an American football jersey sitting on a sofa, a still with financefox.com in the corner.
